summary: Approved for live rerender. Static review and focused validation found no blocker in Builder's orbit flicker stabilization. The implementation directly targets the inspected PNG root causes by discarding no-write warm-up captures before frame_0000, applying deterministic capture settings after Initialize(), recording readback-based metadata, and adding a scene_off_flashlight_off diagnostic for residual baked/environment illumination. Live rerender is still required to prove the PNG-level luma flicker and scene-off brightness are fixed in Unreal output.

findings.message: No blocking findings. examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py:1880-1894 discards warm-up captures after camera sensor setup, and examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py:1924-1938 repeats that no-write capture/readback path after each light setting change, so the previously inspected initial unstable captures should no longer be written as frame_0000.

The prior deterministic-capture ordering risk remains repaired: examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py:1450-1454 calls Initialize()/initialize_sp_funcs() before configure_deterministic_capture_component(), so native Initialize() cannot immediately overwrite bAlwaysPersistRenderingState back to true.

Metadata is now readback-based rather than optimistic. examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py:1320-1337 records per-property set/readback/verified attempts, and examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py:1075-1101 writes those states into each setting metadata.json.

The residual broad scene illumination root cause is handled pragmatically rather than overclaimed. examples/flashlight/orbit_light_settings.json:10-25 adds scene_off_flashlight_off as a diagnostic control, while examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py:465-523 performs best-effort environment contributor disabling with failure-tolerant property/class probing.

Live rerender is still required before claiming the user-visible flicker is fixed. This review did not run Unreal/SPEAR, so frame_0000->frame_0001 luma, loop-closure luma, and scene_off_flashlight_off brightness still need validation on fresh PNG outputs.

follow_up_recommendations: After rerender, recheck PNG-level luma deltas for frame_0000->frame_0001 and frame_last->frame_0000, and compare scene_off_flashlight_off against scene_off_flashlight_on to separate baked/environment illumination from flashlight contribution.
memory_worthy: Inspector approved the orbit flicker stabilization for live rerender: no-write warm-up captures should prevent unstable initial PNG frames from being written, and scene_off_flashlight_off is now the diagnostic for baked/static/environment illumination after scene lights are disabled.
